x: John Hedgethorne (Essex Police) and John Moullin passed him at about 14 miles, and completed the second lap together. The Belgravian now took the lead and retained it until the finish.

We met at John Bromley's headquarters at the Police Cadet Training School, Hendon, and travelling in John's well equipped Dormobile ( which does literally carry the kitchen sink! ) we picked up John Hedgethorne of Essex Cadet School en route.

John Llewellin held on for 10th and held off John Hedgethorne to win the League. In the Ladies, Gail Porter produced a sub 60 minute effort to take another victory and finish 33 overall out of the 52 finishers.
